title: 環形雷射陀螺儀~Ring-laser gyroscopes
focus: Sagnac 拍頻、鎖定與抖動、Zerodur 環腔製作與導航級誤差預算~Sagnac beat frequency, lock-in and dither, Zerodur ring-cavity construction and navigation-grade error budgets
summary: 從主動環形雷射腔中兩道反向行進光束的頻率差出發，推導比例因子 4A/(λL)，理解背向散射鎖定為何需要機械抖動，再把 Zerodur 腔體、超低損耗鏡、對稱放電、路徑長度控制與 Allan 偏差誤差預算整合成可交付的慣性量測單元工程。~Start from the frequency difference between the two counter-propagating beams of an active ring-laser cavity, derive the 4A/(λL) scale factor, see why backscatter lock-in demands mechanical dither, then integrate the Zerodur block, ultralow-loss mirrors, symmetric discharge, path-length control and an Allan-deviation error budget into a deliverable inertial-measurement-unit engineering record.

units.anchor: 反向行進光束與拍頻~Counter-propagating beams and beat frequency
units.title: Sagnac 效應與主動環形腔的比例因子~Sagnac effect and the active-cavity scale factor
units.mechanism: 環形雷射陀螺儀的環形腔內同時振盪順時針與逆時針兩道 HeNe 雷射模態；腔體不轉動時兩者頻率相同，腔體以角速率 Ω 繞法線旋轉時，順轉方向的有效周長變長、逆轉方向變短，兩模態的諧振頻率因此分裂。把兩道光在合光稜鏡上疊加，光電二極體看到的條紋移動速率就是拍頻 Δf，它與 Ω 成正比，比例常數只取決於幾何面積、周長與波長，所以它是一個不含運動件的角速率積分器：累計條紋數就是累計轉角。~A ring-laser gyroscope sustains clockwise and counter-clockwise HeNe modes in one ring cavity. At rest they share one frequency; when the block rotates at rate Ω about its normal, the effective perimeter grows for the co-rotating beam and shrinks for the counter-rotating one, so the two resonances split. Recombined on a prism, the beams give photodiodes a fringe-motion rate equal to the beat frequency Δf, which is proportional to Ω with a constant set only by enclosed area, perimeter and wavelength. The device is therefore a rate integrator with no moving parts: counting fringes counts angle.
units.model: 比例因子 S = 4A/(λL)。教學假設：正三角形環、邊長 0.10 m，則 L = 0.30 m、A = 4.33×10⁻³ m²，λ = 632.8 nm，S = 4×4.33×10⁻³/(632.8×10⁻⁹×0.30) ≈ 9.12×10⁴ Hz/(rad/s)，即約 1592 Hz/(°/s)；一個條紋對應 1/S = 1.10×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 2.26 arcsec。地球自轉 7.292×10⁻⁵ rad/s 給出 6.65 Hz 的滿額拍頻，水平放置在北緯 25° 時只感測垂直分量 sin25° = 0.4226，拍頻 2.81 Hz。~Scale factor S = 4A/(λL). Teaching assumption: an equilateral triangle of side 0.10 m gives L = 0.30 m and A = 4.33×10⁻³ m²; with λ = 632.8 nm, S = 4×4.33×10⁻³/(632.8×10⁻⁹×0.30) ≈ 9.12×10⁴ Hz/(rad/s), about 1592 Hz/(°/s), and one fringe equals 1/S = 1.10×10⁻⁵ rad ≈ 2.26 arcsec. Earth rotation at 7.292×10⁻⁵ rad/s gives a 6.65 Hz full beat; a horizontal ring at 25° N senses only the vertical component sin25° = 0.4226, so 2.81 Hz.
units.verify: 把陀螺儀固定在靜止平台並把輸入軸轉到垂直，以頻率計數器量拍頻並與 S·Ω_E·sinφ 比較；再把輸入軸轉到水平的東西向，拍頻應降到接近鎖定區內，證明感測的是沿法線的旋轉分量。用當地緯度與公開的地球自轉速率反算 S，偏差應在幾十 ppm 內，否則幾何或波長假設有錯。~Fix the gyro on a static platform with its input axis vertical, measure the beat with a frequency counter and compare with S·Ω_E·sinφ; then turn the input axis horizontal east–west and confirm the beat falls toward the lock-in band, proving that only the component along the normal is sensed. Back out S from the local latitude and the public Earth rate; the discrepancy should be within tens of ppm or the geometry or wavelength assumption is wrong.
units.failure: 若把腔長計算成實體周長而忽略氣體折射率與鏡面相位深度，S 會偏差數十 ppm；在一小時 10,000° 的累計轉動中，50 ppm 的比例因子誤差等於 0.5° 的航向誤差，遠超過導航級允收。~Computing cavity length as the physical perimeter while ignoring gas refractive index and mirror phase depth biases S by tens of ppm; over 10,000° accumulated in an hour, a 50 ppm scale-factor error equals 0.5° of heading error, far beyond navigation-grade acceptance.
units.misconception: 環形雷射陀螺儀像機械陀螺一樣靠角動量守恆感測旋轉。~A ring-laser gyro senses rotation through angular-momentum conservation like a spinning-mass gyro.

units.anchor: 背向散射與抖動馬達~Backscatter and dither motor
units.title: 鎖定門檻、Adler 方程與機械抖動~Lock-in threshold, the Adler equation and mechanical dither
units.mechanism: 鏡面上奈米級的散射把一小部分順時針光耦合到逆時針模態，兩個振盪器因而互相牽引；當拍頻低於耦合強度時，兩模態鎖成同一頻率，陀螺儀對小角速率完全沒有輸出。這個死區由 Adler 鎖定方程 dψ/dt = Δω − ω_L·sinψ 描述，ω_L 正比於每圈的背向散射振幅 r_s 乘以自由光譜範圍 c/L。工程解法是讓整個腔體以數百赫茲作微小扭轉抖動，使瞬時角速率絕大部分時間遠高於鎖定門檻，只在每次過零時留下隨機相位誤差。~Nanometre-scale scatter at the mirrors couples a little clockwise light into the counter-clockwise mode, and the two oscillators pull on each other; when the beat falls below the coupling strength the modes lock to one frequency and the gyro reads zero for small rates. The dead band follows the Adler equation dψ/dt = Δω − ω_L·sinψ, with ω_L proportional to the per-round-trip backscatter amplitude r_s times the free spectral range c/L. The engineering remedy twists the whole block at a few hundred hertz so that the instantaneous rate stays far above threshold almost all the time, leaving only a random phase error at each zero crossing.
units.model: 鎖定拍頻 f_L ≈ c·r_s/(2πL)，換成角速率 Ω_L = f_L/S = cλr_s/(8πA)。取 r_s = 1×10⁻⁶、L = 0.30 m：f_L ≈ 159 Hz，Ω_L ≈ 1.74×10⁻³ rad/s ≈ 0.10 °/s ≈ 360 °/h。抖動 400 Hz、峰值幅度 100 arcsec 時峰值角速率 Ω_d = 2π·400·4.85×10⁻⁴ ≈ 1.22 rad/s ≈ 70 °/s，死區時間占比約 (2/π)(Ω_L/Ω_d) ≈ 9×10⁻⁴；正弦抖動下殘餘角度隨機漫步的量級估計 ARW ≈ Ω_L/√(2π·S·Ω_d) ≈ 2.1×10⁻⁶ rad/√s ≈ 0.007 °/√h。~Lock-in beat f_L ≈ c·r_s/(2πL), or in rate Ω_L = f_L/S = cλr_s/(8πA). With r_s = 1×10⁻⁶ and L = 0.30 m: f_L ≈ 159 Hz, Ω_L ≈ 1.74×10⁻³ rad/s ≈ 0.10 °/s ≈ 360 °/h. Dither at 400 Hz with 100 arcsec peak gives Ω_d = 2π·400·4.85×10⁻⁴ ≈ 1.22 rad/s ≈ 70 °/s, a dead-band time fraction of about (2/π)(Ω_L/Ω_d) ≈ 9×10⁻⁴, and an order-of-magnitude residual angle random walk ARW ≈ Ω_L/√(2π·S·Ω_d) ≈ 2.1×10⁻⁶ rad/√s ≈ 0.007 °/√h.
units.verify: 關閉抖動，把陀螺儀放在速率轉台上由零緩慢加速，記錄拍頻首次出現的輸入速率，就是鎖定門檻；再開啟抖動，用抖動拾取器訊號從輸出中剝除抖動分量，確認低速率輸出恢復線性，並以長時間靜態資料的 Allan 偏差斜率 −1/2 段估計 ARW，與模型比較數量級。~With dither off, place the gyro on a rate table and ramp slowly from zero; the input rate at which a beat first appears is the lock-in threshold. Turn dither on, strip the dither component from the output using the dither pick-off signal, confirm that low-rate output is linear again, and estimate ARW from the slope −1/2 segment of a long static Allan deviation, comparing order of magnitude with the model.
units.failure: 鏡面微粒污染或鍍膜老化使 r_s 上升一個數量級，鎖定門檻隨之上升十倍、ARW 同步惡化；若抖動振幅又因撓性彈簧疲勞下降，死區占比急升，靜態漂移與隨機漫步同時超出規格。~Particle contamination or coating ageing that raises r_s by an order of magnitude raises the lock-in threshold tenfold and degrades ARW with it; if the dither amplitude also drops through flexure-spring fatigue, the dead-band fraction jumps and both static drift and random walk exceed specification.
units.misconception: 鎖定只是靈敏度降低，用更高增益的放大器就能讀出小角速率。~Lock-in merely lowers sensitivity, so a higher-gain amplifier can still read small rates.

units.anchor: Zerodur 腔體與超低損耗鏡~Zerodur block and ultralow-loss mirrors
units.title: 低膨脹腔體、鏡面損耗與增益餘裕~Low-expansion block, mirror loss and gain margin
units.mechanism: 腔體由單塊 Zerodur 玻璃陶瓷鑽孔而成，三面或四面鏡以光學接觸直接貼在拋光的端面上，不用黏膠，使腔長與鏡面角度不隨溫度與時間漂移。鏡子是離子束濺鍍的多層介電質超鏡，單鏡散射加吸收只有數 ppm，因為 HeNe 在 632.8 nm 的單程增益只有千分之幾，整圈損耗必須遠小於增益才能起振，同時低散射又直接壓低鎖定門檻。~The block is a single piece of Zerodur glass-ceramic with bored channels; three or four mirrors are optically contacted to polished end faces without adhesive, so cavity length and mirror angles do not drift with temperature or time. The mirrors are ion-beam-sputtered dielectric supermirrors with a few ppm of scatter plus absorption per mirror, because the single-pass HeNe gain at 632.8 nm is only a few tenths of a percent: round-trip loss must stay well below gain for oscillation, and low scatter also directly lowers the lock-in threshold.
units.model: 熱膨脹造成的腔長變化 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。取 Zerodur 0 級 α = 0.02 ppm/K、L = 0.30 m、ΔT = 10 K：ΔL = 2×10⁻⁸×0.30×10 = 60 nm，約 0.1 個波長，對應光頻移 Δν = ν·ΔL/L ≈ 4.74×10¹⁴×2×10⁻⁷ ≈ 95 MHz，相對於約 1.5 GHz 的 HeNe 增益頻寬並不小，所以仍需主動路徑長度控制。損耗預算：三面鏡各 30 ppm 加繞射與窗口 10 ppm，整圈 100 ppm，對比 1000 ppm 的單程增益留有 10 倍餘裕。~Thermal cavity-length change is ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With Zerodur class 0 at α = 0.02 ppm/K, L = 0.30 m and ΔT = 10 K: ΔL = 2×10⁻⁸×0.30×10 = 60 nm, about 0.1 wavelength, an optical-frequency shift Δν = ν·ΔL/L ≈ 4.74×10¹⁴×2×10⁻⁷ ≈ 95 MHz, not small against the roughly 1.5 GHz HeNe gain bandwidth, so active path-length control is still needed. Loss budget: three mirrors at 30 ppm each plus 10 ppm diffraction and apertures give 100 ppm per round trip against a 1000 ppm single-pass gain, a tenfold margin.
units.verify: 以腔衰盪法（cavity ring-down）量每面鏡的總損耗並與供應商的 ppm 規格比對；把腔體放進溫控箱做 ±10 K 循環，記錄路徑長度控制壓電電壓的變化，由壓電的 nm/V 係數反推 ΔL，與 α·L·ΔT 的預測比較以確認 Zerodur 等級與光學接觸的穩定性。~Measure each mirror's total loss by cavity ring-down and compare with the supplier's ppm specification; cycle the block ±10 K in a thermal chamber, log the path-length-control piezo voltage, convert through the piezo nm/V coefficient to ΔL and compare with the α·L·ΔT prediction to confirm the Zerodur grade and the stability of the optical contacts.
units.failure: 光學接觸面若殘留微粒或濕氣，接觸會在溫度循環中局部脫開，鏡面角度跳動數 µrad，使模態橫向偏移、損耗突增而熄振；用黏膠補救則引入潛變與除氣污染鏡面。~Residual particles or moisture at an optical contact let the contact partially release under thermal cycling, the mirror angle jumps by microradians, the mode walks laterally, loss spikes and the laser extinguishes; gluing as a remedy brings creep and outgassing that contaminates the mirrors.
units.misconception: 普通高反射雷射鏡（反射率 99.9%）就足以讓環形雷射起振。~An ordinary 99.9% high-reflectivity laser mirror is enough to make a ring laser oscillate.

units.anchor: 對稱放電與路徑長度控制~Symmetric discharge and path-length control
units.title: 增益氣體、Langmuir 流與路徑長度控制~Gain gas, Langmuir flow and path-length control
units.mechanism: 腔內以直流放電激發 He-Ne 混合氣，一個陰極配兩個對稱的陽極，使兩段放電的氣體流動方向相反而相互抵消；放電中離子拖動中性氣體產生的 Langmuir 流會透過 Fresnel 拖曳效應讓兩方向光速不同，若不對稱就變成假旋轉。氖氣採用 Ne-20 與 Ne-22 約等比例混合，使兩同位素的增益峰錯開，避免兩反向模態在同一組原子上競爭而互相熄滅。路徑長度控制以壓電驅動一面鏡子，鎖住總光強最大的腔長，使雷射始終工作在增益曲線中心。~A dc discharge excites the He-Ne mixture with one cathode and two symmetric anodes so that gas flow in the two discharge legs runs in opposite directions and cancels; ions dragging neutral gas produce Langmuir flow, and through Fresnel drag the two beams then see different light speeds, which reads as false rotation if asymmetric. Neon is a near-equal mix of Ne-20 and Ne-22 so the isotopes' gain peaks are offset and the two counter-propagating modes do not compete for the same atoms and quench each other. Path-length control drives one mirror with a piezo to hold the cavity length at maximum total intensity, keeping the laser at the centre of the gain curve.
units.model: Fresnel 拖曳的光程差 Δ_opt = 2·l·(n² − 1)·v/c，對應拍頻 Δf = c·Δ_opt/(λL)。教學假設放電段長 l = 0.10 m、低壓氣體 n − 1 = 2.3×10⁻⁷、殘餘不對稱流速 v = 0.1 m/s：Δ_opt ≈ 3.1×10⁻¹⁷ m，Δf ≈ 0.048 Hz，除以 S = 9.12×10⁴ Hz/(rad/s) 得假旋轉 5.3×10⁻⁷ rad/s ≈ 0.11 °/h，已是導航級零偏規格（0.01 °/h）的 10 倍，因此放電對稱性必須控制到 1% 以下。~Fresnel-drag optical-path difference is Δ_opt = 2·l·(n² − 1)·v/c and the resulting beat is Δf = c·Δ_opt/(λL). Teaching assumptions: discharge leg l = 0.10 m, low-pressure gas with n − 1 = 2.3×10⁻⁷, residual asymmetric flow v = 0.1 m/s: Δ_opt ≈ 3.1×10⁻¹⁷ m, Δf ≈ 0.048 Hz, and dividing by S = 9.12×10⁴ Hz/(rad/s) gives a false rotation of 5.3×10⁻⁷ rad/s ≈ 0.11 °/h, ten times a navigation-grade bias specification of 0.01 °/h, so discharge symmetry must be held below 1%.
units.verify: 靜態下交替改變兩陽極的電流分配（例如 ±2%），記錄零偏隨電流差的斜率，就得到流動不對稱的靈敏度係數；再掃描路徑長度控制的設定點，確認零偏與比例因子在增益曲線中心附近對腔長的敏感度最低，並把工作點鎖在那裡。~At rest, deliberately shift the current split between the two anodes (for example ±2%) and record the slope of bias against current imbalance to obtain the flow-asymmetry sensitivity; then sweep the path-length-control set point and confirm that bias and scale factor are least sensitive to cavity length near the gain-curve centre, locking the operating point there.
units.failure: 陰極濺射把氣體吸入或 He 透過玻璃緩慢滲漏，使氣壓與同位素比例改變：增益下降、兩模態開始競爭而強度交替閃爍，零偏隨壓力漂移；路徑長度控制若鎖到旁邊的縱模，比例因子會跳一個離散值。~Cathode sputtering that pumps gas or slow helium permeation through the glass changes pressure and isotope ratio: gain falls, the two modes start competing and flicker alternately, and bias drifts with pressure; if path-length control locks onto an adjacent longitudinal mode, the scale factor jumps by a discrete step.
units.misconception: 只要氣體夠純，單一陽極的放電也不會產生零偏。~With pure enough gas, a single-anode discharge introduces no bias.

units.anchor: 速率轉台與正交讀出~Rate table and quadrature readout
units.title: 比例因子校正與條紋計數讀出~Scale-factor calibration and fringe-counting readout
units.mechanism: 合光稜鏡讓兩道輸出光以極小夾角重疊，形成空間條紋，兩個相隔四分之一條紋的光電二極體給出正交訊號，條紋移動方向決定旋轉方向，每個條紋邊緣都可計數，四倍解碼後角度解析度是條紋週期的四分之一。比例因子的校正在速率轉台上進行：轉台用自身的角度編碼器提供整數圈的精確轉角，陀螺儀累計的計數除以轉角就是 S，再分別在正反轉、不同速率與溫度下重複，建立比例因子的線性度與溫度係數表。~The combining prism overlaps the two output beams at a tiny angle to form spatial fringes; two photodiodes a quarter fringe apart give quadrature signals, the direction of fringe motion gives the sign of rotation, every fringe edge can be counted, and fourfold decoding resolves a quarter of a fringe period. Scale factor is calibrated on a rate table whose own angle encoder provides exact whole-turn angles: accumulated gyro counts divided by the table angle give S, repeated in both directions, at several rates and temperatures, to build linearity and temperature-coefficient tables.
units.model: 轉台以 100 °/s 轉 100 s，轉角 10,000° = 174.53 rad，理想計數 N = S·θ = 9.12×10⁴×174.53 ≈ 1.59×10⁷ 條紋；若 S 有 5 ppm 誤差，計數差 ≈ 80 條紋，乘以 2.26 arcsec/條紋 ≈ 180 arcsec = 0.05°。四倍正交解碼後單次讀出量化誤差為 2.26/4 ≈ 0.57 arcsec，對校正結果可忽略，但比例因子要校到 1 ppm 需要轉台角度本身優於 0.036 arcsec/10,000°。~Rotate the table at 100 °/s for 100 s: 10,000° = 174.53 rad, ideal count N = S·θ = 9.12×10⁴×174.53 ≈ 1.59×10⁷ fringes; a 5 ppm error in S changes the count by ≈ 80 fringes, which at 2.26 arcsec per fringe is ≈ 180 arcsec = 0.05°. After fourfold quadrature decoding the single-readout quantisation is 2.26/4 ≈ 0.57 arcsec, negligible for calibration, but calibrating S to 1 ppm needs the table angle itself to be good to 0.036 arcsec over 10,000°.
units.verify: 以整數圈（例如 ±10 圈）為單位校正，避免轉台編碼器的週期誤差；比較正轉與反轉算出的 S，差值反映讀出的方向不對稱或抖動剝除殘餘；在 −40 到 +70 °C 間重複，擬合 S 的溫度係數（ppm/K）並寫進補償表，最後用獨立的多面稜鏡加自準直儀交叉驗證轉台角度。~Calibrate on whole turns (for example ±10 turns) to cancel encoder periodic error; compare S from forward and reverse runs, whose difference exposes readout direction asymmetry or residual dither stripping; repeat between −40 and +70 °C, fit the temperature coefficient of S in ppm/K into the compensation table, and cross-check the table angle with an independent polygon mirror and autocollimator.
units.failure: 光電二極體正交相位偏離 90° 或兩路增益不等時，解碼器在高速下漏計或多計邊緣，比例因子看似與速率有關；若把這種讀出錯誤當成光學非線性去補償，換一個轉台速率就又不對。~Quadrature phase off 90° or unequal channel gains make the decoder miss or double-count edges at high rate, so the scale factor appears rate dependent; compensating this readout fault as optical non-linearity fails as soon as the table rate changes.
units.misconception: 比例因子由幾何決定，所以一經設計就不需要校正。~Scale factor is fixed by geometry, so a designed value needs no calibration.

units.title: 零偏、隨機漫步與導航級誤差預算~Bias, random walk and the navigation-grade error budget
units.mechanism: 靜態長時間資料的 Allan 偏差把雜訊按時間尺度拆開：短平均時間下斜率 −1/2 的段落是白雜訊角速率，即角度隨機漫步 ARW；曲線底部的平坦段是零偏不穩定度，來自放電、溫度與磁場的慢變；更長時間若斜率轉為 +1/2，是速率隨機漫步或溫度趨勢。導航級規格通常要求零偏不穩定度 0.01 °/h 等級、ARW 0.005 °/√h 等級，並把各項按均方根合成，再換算成航向與位置誤差。~An Allan deviation of long static data separates noise by time scale: the slope −1/2 segment at short averaging times is white rate noise, the angle random walk ARW; the flat floor is bias instability from slow discharge, temperature and magnetic changes; a later rise with slope +1/2 is rate random walk or a temperature trend. Navigation-grade specifications typically ask for bias instability of order 0.01 °/h and ARW of order 0.005 °/√h, combined root-sum-square and converted into heading and position error.
units.model: 白雜訊段 σ(τ) = ARW/√τ（τ 以小時計）。取 ARW = 0.005 °/√h：τ = 1 s 時 σ = 0.005/√(1/3600) = 0.30 °/h；τ = 100 s 時 0.030 °/h；τ = 1000 s 時 0.0095 °/h，之後被 0.003 °/h 的零偏不穩定度底部截斷。航向預算：零偏 0.01 °/h 在 1 h 內累積 0.01° = 1.75×10⁻⁴ rad，以 500 km 航程計橫向位置誤差約 87 m，這是純陀螺項，尚未含加速度計與對準誤差。~White-noise segment σ(τ) = ARW/√τ with τ in hours. For ARW = 0.005 °/√h: at τ = 1 s, σ = 0.005/√(1/3600) = 0.30 °/h; at τ = 100 s, 0.030 °/h; at τ = 1000 s, 0.0095 °/h, after which a 0.003 °/h bias-instability floor takes over. Heading budget: a 0.01 °/h bias accumulates 0.01° = 1.75×10⁻⁴ rad in 1 h, about 87 m of cross-track error over 500 km, the pure gyro term before accelerometer and alignment errors.
units.verify: 在溫度穩定的靜態平台上連續記錄至少 12 小時，計算重疊 Allan 偏差並辨認 −1/2、0、+1/2 三段，讀出 ARW 與零偏不穩定度；同時記錄溫度與放電電流，用回歸找出零偏對溫度的靈敏度（°/h/K），補償後重算 Allan 偏差，確認底部下降而短時段不變。~Record at least 12 hours continuously on a temperature-stable static platform, compute the overlapping Allan deviation, identify the −1/2, 0 and +1/2 segments and read ARW and bias instability; log temperature and discharge current in parallel, regress the bias temperature sensitivity in °/h per K, compensate and recompute to confirm the floor drops while the short-τ segment is unchanged.
units.failure: 用太短的資料集算 Allan 偏差，長 τ 的點只有幾個樣本，底部被低估，交付的零偏不穩定度比真實值好一個因子二；在飛行中這會以航向緩慢漂移的形式出現，而使用者以為是對準問題。~Allan deviation from too short a record has only a few samples at long τ, the floor is underestimated and the delivered bias instability is a factor of two optimistic; in flight it appears as slow heading drift that the user mistakes for an alignment problem.
units.misconception: 平均時間越長，陀螺儀的雜訊一定越小。~Longer averaging always makes gyro noise smaller.

units.anchor: 三軸抖動座與誤準矩陣~Three-axis dithered mount and misalignment matrix
units.title: 慣性量測單元整合與軸間誤準校正~Inertial-measurement-unit integration and inter-axis misalignment
units.mechanism: 三顆環形雷射陀螺儀與三顆加速度計裝在一個共用的感測器座上，輸入軸互相正交；每顆陀螺儀各自有抖動撓性件，抖動頻率刻意錯開數十赫茲，避免互相拍頻並透過底座耦合成假訊號。整機的誤準矩陣（非正交與相對於外殼基準面的旋轉）在多位置、多速率測試中解算，與比例因子、零偏一起寫入補償韌體；環形雷射陀螺儀對加速度不敏感，是它優於機械陀螺的關鍵，但抖動座的共振與振動整流仍必須在整機層級驗證。~Three ring-laser gyros and three accelerometers sit on one shared sensor mount with mutually orthogonal input axes; each gyro has its own dither flexure and the dither frequencies are deliberately staggered by tens of hertz so they do not beat against each other and couple through the base as false signals. The unit's misalignment matrix (non-orthogonality and rotation relative to the housing reference faces) is solved from multi-position, multi-rate tests and written into compensation firmware alongside scale factors and biases; insensitivity to acceleration is the ring-laser gyro's key advantage over spinning-mass gyros, but dither-mount resonances and vibration rectification must still be verified at unit level.
units.model: 若 Y 軸陀螺儀的輸入軸對 X 軸有 100 µrad 的非正交，則在 X 軸 100 °/s 的機動中 Y 軸多感測 1×10⁻⁴×100 = 0.01 °/s = 36 °/h，比零偏規格大三個數量級，所以誤準必須校正到 10 µrad 以下，殘餘 36 °/h×(10/100) = 3.6 °/h 再靠機動持續時間短而被平均。抖動頻率配置例：380、420、460 Hz，最小差 40 Hz，遠離 1 Hz 以下的導航頻帶。~If the Y gyro input axis is 100 µrad non-orthogonal to X, a 100 °/s manoeuvre about X leaks 1×10⁻⁴×100 = 0.01 °/s = 36 °/h into Y, three orders above the bias specification, so misalignment must be calibrated below 10 µrad, leaving 36 °/h×(10/100) = 3.6 °/h that is tolerable only because manoeuvres are short. Example dither allocation: 380, 420 and 460 Hz, a minimum spacing of 40 Hz, far from the sub-1 Hz navigation band.
units.verify: 在雙軸轉台上做六位置靜態測試與各軸正反向速率測試，用最小平方法解出 3×3 誤準矩陣與零偏；再以隨機振動台掃描 20 到 2000 Hz，監視每顆陀螺儀輸出中是否出現抖動差頻或底座共振引起的整流零偏，並確認補償後各軸交叉耦合小於 10 µrad。~Run six-position static tests and forward/reverse rate tests about each axis on a two-axis table, solve the 3×3 misalignment matrix and biases by least squares; then sweep 20 to 2000 Hz random vibration and watch each gyro output for dither difference frequencies or base-resonance rectified bias, confirming cross-coupling below 10 µrad after compensation.
units.failure: 兩顆陀螺儀的抖動頻率因撓性件製造差異而接近到幾赫茲，差頻落進導航頻帶，卡爾曼濾波器把它當成真實角速率，姿態輸出出現週期性擺動；症狀只在三顆同時運轉時出現，單顆測試看不到。~Two gyros whose dither frequencies drift within a few hertz of each other through flexure manufacturing spread put their difference frequency inside the navigation band; the Kalman filter treats it as real rate and attitude output oscillates. The symptom appears only with all three running and is invisible in single-gyro tests.
units.misconception: 環形雷射陀螺儀沒有運動件，所以整機不需要振動測試。~A ring-laser gyro has no moving parts, so the assembled unit needs no vibration testing.

units.anchor: 陀螺羅經對準與驗收報告~Gyrocompass alignment and acceptance record
units.title: 陀螺羅經驗證、環境試驗與工程交接~Gyrocompass validation, environmental tests and handoff
units.mechanism: 整機最嚴格的功能驗證是靜態陀螺羅經對準：單元只靠量到的地球自轉水平分量 Ω_E·cosφ 找出真北，航向誤差直接由水平軸的零偏與一段對準時間內的 ARW 平均決定，因此這一項同時檢驗零偏、隨機漫步與誤準。驗收還包括溫度循環、振動、衝擊與電磁相容後重複上述測試，並比較校正參數在試驗前後的漂移。交接文件必須含比例因子、零偏、誤準矩陣、溫度係數、Allan 偏差曲線與鎖定門檻，使用者才能設定濾波器與判斷可用壽命。~The most demanding functional check of the finished unit is static gyrocompass alignment: using only the measured horizontal Earth-rate component Ω_E·cosφ the unit finds true north, and the heading error follows directly from horizontal-axis bias and the ARW averaged over the alignment time, so this one test exercises bias, random walk and misalignment together. Acceptance repeats it after thermal cycling, vibration, shock and electromagnetic-compatibility exposure and compares calibration parameters before and after. The handoff package must contain scale factors, biases, misalignment matrix, temperature coefficients, Allan-deviation curves and lock-in thresholds so the user can tune filters and judge usable life.
units.model: 航向誤差 δψ ≈ δΩ/(Ω_E·cosφ)。在北緯 25°，Ω_E·cosφ = 15.04×0.906 = 13.63 °/h。水平軸零偏 0.01 °/h 給 δψ = 7.3×10⁻⁴ rad ≈ 2.5 arcmin；對準 10 min 時 ARW 0.005 °/√h 的平均殘餘為 0.005/√(1/6) = 0.012 °/h，再給 3.1 arcmin；兩者均方根合成約 4.0 arcmin ≈ 0.066°。在高緯度 60°，分母縮為 7.5 °/h，同樣誤差源給出近兩倍的航向誤差。~Heading error δψ ≈ δΩ/(Ω_E·cosφ). At 25° N, Ω_E·cosφ = 15.04×0.906 = 13.63 °/h. A horizontal-axis bias of 0.01 °/h gives δψ = 7.3×10⁻⁴ rad ≈ 2.5 arcmin; over a 10 min alignment an ARW of 0.005 °/√h leaves 0.005/√(1/6) = 0.012 °/h, another 3.1 arcmin; the root-sum-square is about 4.0 arcmin ≈ 0.066°. At 60° latitude the denominator shrinks to 7.5 °/h and the same error sources give nearly twice the heading error.
units.verify: 把單元放在已知真北方位（以天文或大地測量基準標定到 0.5 arcmin 內）的基座上，做 20 次 10 min 對準，統計航向誤差的平均與標準差：平均值反映零偏與誤準，標準差反映 ARW；環境試驗後重做並要求參數漂移小於允收門檻，所有數據與校正表一起進入交接文件。~Place the unit on a pedestal whose true-north azimuth is known to 0.5 arcmin from astronomical or geodetic reference, run 20 alignments of 10 min each and compute the mean and standard deviation of heading error: the mean reflects bias and misalignment, the standard deviation reflects ARW; repeat after environmental exposure, require parameter drift below the acceptance threshold and put all data and calibration tables into the handoff package.
units.failure: 若驗收只做單顆陀螺儀的靜態漂移而不做整機陀螺羅經，誤準矩陣與抖動耦合的錯誤不會被發現；交到使用者手上後在高緯度的航向誤差加倍，被誤判為安裝基準面問題而拆裝重校，浪費數週。~Acceptance that measures only single-gyro static drift and skips unit-level gyrocompassing never exposes misalignment-matrix or dither-coupling errors; delivered to a high-latitude user the heading error doubles, is misread as a mounting-face problem and costs weeks of removal and recalibration.
units.misconception: 陀螺羅經的航向精度只取決於陀螺儀零偏，與對準時間無關。~Gyrocompass heading accuracy depends only on gyro bias and not on alignment time.

example: 環形雷射陀螺儀設計練習：正三角形環、邊長 0.10 m，L = 0.30 m，A = (√3/4)×0.01 = 4.33×10⁻³ m²，λ = 632.8 nm。比例因子 S = 4A/(λL) = 0.01732/(1.898×10⁻⁷) ≈ 9.12×10⁴ Hz/(rad/s)，每條紋 2.26 arcsec。在北緯 25° 水平放置，地球自轉拍頻 = 9.12×10⁴×7.292×10⁻⁵×0.4226 ≈ 2.81 Hz。取背向散射 r_s = 1×10⁻⁶：f_L = c·r_s/(2πL) ≈ 159 Hz，鎖定門檻 Ω_L = 159/9.12×10⁴ ≈ 1.74×10⁻³ rad/s ≈ 0.10 °/s，比地球自轉大 24 倍，所以不抖動就讀不到地球自轉。加入 400 Hz、100 arcsec 峰值的抖動：Ω_d ≈ 1.22 rad/s ≈ 70 °/s，殘餘 ARW ≈ Ω_L/√(2π·S·Ω_d) ≈ 2.1×10⁻⁶ rad/√s ≈ 0.007 °/√h。若零偏不穩定度 0.01 °/h，10 min 陀螺羅經對準的航向誤差 ≈ √(2.5² + 4.3²) arcmin ≈ 5 arcmin（ARW 0.007 °/√h 的 10 min 殘餘為 0.017 °/h → 4.3 arcmin）。所有數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Ring-laser gyro design exercise: equilateral triangle of side 0.10 m, L = 0.30 m, A = (√3/4)×0.01 = 4.33×10⁻³ m², λ = 632.8 nm. Scale factor S = 4A/(λL) = 0.01732/(1.898×10⁻⁷) ≈ 9.12×10⁴ Hz/(rad/s), 2.26 arcsec per fringe. Placed horizontally at 25° N, the Earth-rate beat is 9.12×10⁴×7.292×10⁻⁵×0.4226 ≈ 2.81 Hz. With backscatter r_s = 1×10⁻⁶: f_L = c·r_s/(2πL) ≈ 159 Hz and the lock-in threshold Ω_L = 159/9.12×10⁴ ≈ 1.74×10⁻³ rad/s ≈ 0.10 °/s, 24 times Earth rate, so without dither Earth rotation is unreadable. Adding 400 Hz dither at 100 arcsec peak: Ω_d ≈ 1.22 rad/s ≈ 70 °/s and residual ARW ≈ Ω_L/√(2π·S·Ω_d) ≈ 2.1×10⁻⁶ rad/√s ≈ 0.007 °/√h. With 0.01 °/h bias instability, a 10 min gyrocompass alignment gives heading error ≈ √(2.5² + 4.3²) arcmin ≈ 5 arcmin (the 10 min residual of 0.007 °/√h is 0.017 °/h → 4.3 arcmin). All values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
history: Sagnac 在 1913 年以旋轉的環形干涉儀示範了反向光束的相位差；1963 年 Macek 與 Davis 在 Sperry 以 HeNe 環形雷射首次量到旋轉引起的拍頻，鎖定問題隨即被發現並由機械抖動解決。1980 年代 Honeywell 的環形雷射陀螺儀慣性導航系統進入波音民航機，使無運動件的捷聯式導航成為主流；2000 年代起德國 Wettzell 大地測量站的 4 m×4 m 大型環形雷射 G 以連續監測地球自轉的方式把同一物理推到 10⁻⁹ 的相對精度。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。~Sagnac demonstrated the phase difference between counter-propagating beams in a rotating ring interferometer in 1913; in 1963 Macek and Davis at Sperry first measured a rotation-induced beat in a HeNe ring laser, after which lock-in was discovered and solved with mechanical dither. In the 1980s Honeywell ring-laser-gyro inertial navigation entered Boeing airliners and made strapdown navigation without moving parts the mainstream; from the 2000s the 4 m × 4 m large ring laser G at the Wettzell geodetic observatory in Germany pushed the same physics to 10⁻⁹ relative precision by continuously monitoring Earth rotation. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only.
